# DMS (Document / Help Desk Management System) - API Endpoint Documentation > **Base URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api` > **Server Engine:** Express.js + MySQL > **Authentication:** Bearer JWT in `Authorization: Bearer ` or HTTP-only Refresh Cookie > **Postman Ready Files:** > - 📦 **OpenAPI 3.0.3 Spec:** [`openapi.json`](file:///c:/Users/hp/Desktop/DMS/openapi.json) (Direct Postman Import / Swagger UI) > - 🚀 **Postman Collection v2.1.0:** [`dms_postman_collection.json`](file:///c:/Users/hp/Desktop/DMS/dms_postman_collection.json) (Pre-configured 115 requests with token handling) > - 🌐 **Postman Environment:** [`dms_postman_environment.json`](file:///c:/Users/hp/Desktop/DMS/dms_postman_environment.json) (Local environment variables) --- ## 📑 Table of Contents 1. [Authentication & Profile (`/api/auth`)](#1-authentication--profile-apiauth) 2. [Tickets Management (`/api/tickets`)](#2-tickets-management-apitickets) 3. [Dashboard & Analytics (`/api/dashboard`)](#3-dashboard--analytics-apidashboard) 4. [Notices & Announcements (`/api/notices`)](#4-notices--announcements-apinotices) 5. [Testing Setup & Authentication Workflow](#17-testing-setup--authentication-workflow) --- ## 1. Authentication & Profile (`/api/auth`) | Method | Endpoint | Auth / Role | Description | Parameters / Payload | |---|---|---|---|---| | `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | **Public** (Rate limited: 20 req / 15 min) | Authenticate user and obtain access token | **JSON Body:**
• `identifier` (string, username or email)
• `password` (string) | | `POST` | `/api/auth/refresh` | **Public / Cookie** | Refresh expired access token | **Cookie:** `refreshToken`
*(or body `refreshToken`)* | | `GET` | `/api/auth/me` | Authenticated | Get current authenticated user details and permissions | **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer ` | | `POST` | `/api/auth/logout` | Authenticated | Invalidate refresh session and clear cookie | **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer ` | | `PATCH` | `/api/auth/me/profile` | Authenticated | Update current user's profile | **Multipart / JSON:**
• `username?`
• `email?`
• `firstName?`
• `lastName?`
• `phone?`
• `currentPassword?`
• `newPassword?`
• `confirmPassword?`
• `profileImage?` (file) | | `PATCH` | `/api/auth/me/theme` | Authenticated | Save UI theme preference | **JSON Body:**
• `themePreference`: `'system'` \| `'light'` \| `'dark'` | --- ## 2. **JSON Body:**

**JSON Body:**
• `notes?` (string) | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/complete` | `tickets.complete` | Manager marks ticket work completed | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `notes?` (string) | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/approve` | `tickets.approve` \| `tickets.create` | Approve resolution (Admin or Tenant) | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `notes?` (string) | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/reject-completion` | `tickets.approve` \| `tickets.create` | Reject completion/resolution | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `notes?` (string) | | `PATCH` | `/api/tickets/:id/priority` | `tickets.change_priority` \| `tickets.assign` | Change ticket priority | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `priority`: `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `urgent` | | `PATCH` | `/api/tickets/:id/category` | `tickets.change_category` \| `tickets.assign` | Change ticket category | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `category`: string | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/internal-note` | `tickets.internal_note` | Add private note (staff/admin/manager) | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
• `message` (string)

**JSON Body:**
• `status` (string)
• `notes?`
• `departmentId?`
• `assignedTo?` | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/attachments` | `tickets.read` \| `tickets.create` | Upload ticket attachments | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**Multipart Form:** `attachments` (max 5) | | `POST` | `/api/tickets/:id/replies` | `tickets.read` \| `tickets.create` | Add public or internal reply | **Path:** `id` (UUID)
**JSON Body:**
